ctx.stageWhatCompact: compresses the whole conversation into one structured summary, then carries on

ctx.stageWhatSweep: replaces old tool output with a summary + placeholder; the original history stays in the session file
ctx.stagesTip: The three working-set stages: Sweep replaces old tool output with a summary (70%), Fold turns finished work into a conclusion (85%), Compact compresses the whole conversation (100%). Dashed stages are not wired up yet and will not fire.
ctx.tip:
Used {used} / limit {win} ({pct}%)
Turns amber at 85%, red at 95% — auto-compaction kicks in before it fills
ctx.tipWorkingSet:
Working set used {used} / cap {cap} ({pct}%) — compacts at the line

ctx.workingSetTip: The effective limit derived from min(240k, window×70%, window−reserve−margin); at this line the app asks pi to compact — far earlier than the physical window

set.ctxHint: Leave empty to use the default. Changes apply immediately, no restart

set.ctxModelHint: Leave empty and save to remove this model override

set.ctxModelPresetDesc: Writes only to this exact model; verify endpoint capacity and output budget first — still needs measurement

set.ctxPresetDesc: The reference preset only changes the cap and window ratio; the stages stay Yan’s three, no extra stages appear
set.ctxRatioDesc: The working set never exceeds this share of the model window. Default 0.7
set.ctxReserveDesc: Space kept for the model answer. Default 32000; small windows are lowered by formula
set.ctxSource.off: Auto compaction is off — the working-set view does not apply
set.deepDescOff: Off (default): answers use the context as-is. When on, Yan runs one extra call after you ask and before the model answers, condensing "where this task stands right now" into a short brief inserted into the context — useful for cross-file debugging and long sessions. It costs up to 30s of extra waiting per turn plus one extra call. It only kicks in when the context is long, and only once per question. Takes effect immediately.
set.deepDescOn: On: one extra summarization call after each question, before the model answers (up to 30s of extra waiting). It only runs when the context exceeds 150k tokens, and only once per question. Turn it off here if it feels slow or spends too much quota — takes effect immediately.
set.defaultWorkModeDesc: Applies to new sessions only; each existing session keeps its own mode — changeable under Workspace (Ctrl+Tab cycles)
set.densityDesc: Changes spacing only — never font size (Chinese glyphs are pixel-aligned at 12.5px). Standard is identical to before.
set.extToolsDesc: Web search depends on OpenCLI (you install it; Inkstone only detects and diagnoses). Deep browser control uses Inkstone's own CDP connection and needs no extension.
set.foldDescOff: Off: no task state is generated, and none is put into the context. State files already written stay in the local data directory (they are not deleted) and are picked up again if you turn this back on. Takes effect immediately.
set.foldDescOn: On by default: once the context is long enough and the turn actually changed something, Yan runs one extra call after the turn to write down where the task stands (files touched, commands run, open items, conclusions), and puts that state before the history on the next turn — less likely to lose the thread in cross-file debugging and long sessions. Short sessions and read-only turns do not trigger it. Turn it off here to save quota; takes effect immediately.
set.knDeleteAsk: A deleted entry leaves the search set. Logical delete keeps the text and can be restored; permanent delete leaves a tombstone without text (old candidates cannot come back).
set.knDescOff: Off: no search, no injection, no candidates. Saved entries stay put; you can turn it back on anytime.
set.knDescOn: Before answering, the app searches confirmed entries in this project’s knowledge and your personal memory for the current question (up to 8 entries / 2k tokens) and passes them along as sourced material. Nothing is injected when nothing matches.
set.knEmpty: No entries yet. What the model proposes with `yan knowledge propose` shows up under “Pending”.
set.knExportHint: Exports the current state (deleted entries excluded); copy it or save to a file. It never rewrites docs in the repo.
set.knExportManual: Clipboard unavailable: the text is in the editor above, copy it manually
set.knIpcFailed: Lost connection to the main process — try again
set.knNoProject: This session has no project working directory, so project knowledge is unavailable. Start a session inside a project first.
set.knReplaceHint: Write a new entry that replaces this one. The old one is kept as “Superseded” (history stays readable).
set.langDesc: Affects the UI only. Replies and tool output pass through untouched
set.logsDesc: Last {n} lines (extension notices and pi stderr)
set.piBundledMissing: The bundled runtime is missing. Dev: run `npm run vendor:pi`. Installed build: reinstall the app.
set.piShellWarn: Falling back to the shell `pi`; prompts with special characters may break.
set.recentCwdDesc: Switch the working directory in one click (your recently used folders)
set.replayOnboardDesc: Reopen the “Before you start” checklist from first launch (pi / model access / connectivity); does not reset the seen flag
set.searchBackendExtHint: Electron does not support chrome.debugger, so load the extension in your own Chrome (see `opencli doctor`) and then connect with yan browser connect-chrome.
set.searchBackendExtOff: Ready · v{version}, but the browser extension is not connected
set.searchBackendMissing: Not detected (yan search will honestly report “backend unavailable”, never “no results”)
set.searchBackendProbeFailed: Check failed (the probe itself could not run; try Recheck again)
set.searchBackendNodeHint: Node.js required: put node (>=20.18.1) on PATH, or point YAN_NODE_BIN at it.
set.searchBackendUnusable: Backend installed (v{version}), but its commands fail (search will fail)
set.searchBackendUnusableHint: Raw probe output below. Usual causes: command-line parsing mismatch with the runtime, or changed OpenCLI behavior.
set.sendKeyDesc: How Enter and Ctrl+Enter behave in the composer. "Auto" = Enter sends normally, and inserts a newline in long-form mode (double-tap Up or drag taller). The active rule is always shown in the composer.
set.sessionHeadDesc: Work mode and agent profile are stored per session; defaults for new sessions live under Appearance.
set.soundDesc: Alert you when a turn finishes, you are asked to answer, or something errors: play a sound and/or show a system notification when the window is not focused (like opencode's attention)
set.soundEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, the per-event switches below do nothing
set.soundEventDoneDesc: When a reply completes and the agent stops working
set.soundEventErrorDesc: When the pi process or an extension reports an error
set.soundEventQuestionDesc: When the model or an extension asks you to choose, confirm or type
set.soundNotifyDesc: Shown only when the window is not focused; clicking one brings the window back. Independent from the sound switch
set.soundNotifyTestBody: If you can see this, system notifications work
set.soundVolumeDesc: Releasing the slider previews at the new volume
set.spaceManageDesc: A space groups sessions across projects. Create, rename or archive here; putting a session into a space stays in the session menu.
set.streamWidthDesc: Messages, composer, usage bar and the left navigation rail all share one width; drag to apply instantly
set.themeDesc: Dark is polished; light has full tokens but isn’t fine-tuned
set.title: Settings
set.toolDetailDesc: Off by default: a tool call stays one line — starting, streaming and finishing never expand on their own; click any row to inspect (history always remains readable). On expands only the running call into a terminal window
set.uiScaleDesc: Auto snaps to whole pixels based on your display scaling, so CJK text stays crisp. Also Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0
set.workModeKeyDesc: Press it anywhere to cycle Standard → Plan → Autonomous; click the binding to record a different combo (must include Ctrl / Alt / Shift). Turning it off restores normal Tab focus movement; the mode stays available under Workspace
set.workModeKeyInvalid: Needs a combo with Ctrl / Alt / Shift
set.workModeKeyRecording: Press the new shortcut… (Esc to cancel)
set.workModeNowDesc: Standard / Clarify / Autonomous. The global shortcut is under Appearance.
set.workspaceModeDesc: Coding leans on projects and code context; Daily leans on the workbench and session map. Does not change the model mode.
space.art.bodyPlaceholder: Write here. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
space.art.checklistEmpty: No items yet. Write `- [ ] something` in the body to add one.
space.art.deleteConfirm: Delete this artifact? Its version history goes with it.
space.art.empty: No artifacts yet. Create one, or let the agent file its research into an artifact.
space.art.noSourceText: This source has no readable text (e.g. a binary file).
space.art.select: Pick an artifact, or create one.
space.art.sourceMissing: Source text unavailable (removed, or that version is gone).
space.art.sourceOpen: Open the version that was cited
space.art.sourceTruncated: The text is long; only the beginning is shown.
space.art.toLearnHint: Put a learning request in the composer so the tutor can teach from this artifact
space.art.toLearnPrompt: Teach me using the artifact “{title}” (ID: {id}). Ask what I want to achieve first, then guide me step by step.
space.follow.appOnly: Follow-ups only run while Inkstone is open: the time it was closed is never checked, and missed rounds are not caught up. Clicking one only puts "what to look at" into the input box — sending is your call.
space.follow.defaultPlace: Just a line in the space overview
space.follow.empty: Nothing is being followed yet. An agent can propose one, or you can add your own.
space.follow.lookHint: Only fills the input box; never sends for you
space.follow.newPlace: Where the result goes (default: a line in the overview)
space.follow.proposed: An agent proposed this one, not enabled yet — it only shows up in the due list after you start it.
space.lib.empty: No sources yet. Files added in a session show up here.
space.lib.noSession: Open a session first, then add the source.
space.lib.previewEmpty: This source has no readable text (kept as an attachment).
space.ov.continueNone: No sessions in this space yet.
space.ov.noSpace: This session is not filed to a space yet. Right-click a space in the rail to file it.
space.pendingArtifact: The artifact editor lands in P06 — for now you can only view artifacts.
src.empty: This session has no sources yet. Paste an image, drop a file, or add a URL below.
src.locateHint: Jump to the message(s) this source took part in ({n})
src.note: Removing only drops this session's reference: image copies are deleted, files and web pages only lose the entry — your original files are never deleted, and sent history is never rewritten. It is a link only: no code upload, no session sync, no remote execution.
src.searchPlaceholder: Search keywords (handed to the search capability in this session)
src.title: Sources
status.autoCompactHint: Compact history automatically when context is almost full
status.autoRetryHint: Retry automatically on upstream 5xx / rate limit / overload
term.unavailable: Interactive terminal unavailable: the native dependency failed to load
tl.noRoom: No room for a floating tile here; docked back to the tools page
tok.cacheTip:
cache read {read} · write {write}
hit rate {hit}% (cache read / total prompt)
tok.elapsedTip: wall-clock time for this turn (includes tool round-trips)
tok.elapsedWaitTip: Wall-clock time for this turn (includes tool round-trips and retries); {n} of it spent waiting on tools
tok.liveTip: This provider reports token usage only at the end, so live tok/s is unavailable until settlement.
tok.speedTip: generated in {n}s (excludes queueing and tool round-trips)
tok.speedUnknown: no token usage reported for this turn, so speed can't be computed
tok.usagePartialTip: At least one request in this turn reported no token usage; the total is a lower bound
tool.diffNoPatch: Diff too large — only line counts are shown
tool.diffTooLarge: Larger than 2MB — contents weren't read for a line-by-line diff
tool.notApplied: Not applied — the content below is only what it attempted
tool.wsConcurrent: Another task is running in the same directory — changes in this window can't be attributed to this call (they may include other tasks' or your own edits)
tool.wsNoLine: Contents weren't read — status and size only (so no line counts)
tool.wsTruncated: Directory too large or has unreadable subdirectories — the snapshot is incomplete
tool.wsUnreadable: Working directory was unreadable at the time
turn.merged: This turn spans {n} model round-trips, shown merged
wb.goalNone: This session has no goal yet.
workMode.desc.autonomous: No questions; diagnoses the problem and fixes it on its own
workMode.desc.clarify: Reads the code, writes a plan; starts once you confirm
workMode.desc.standard: Runs normally; asks you first when a request is ambiguous
remote.setupDesc: Connect both devices to the same Tailscale network, then pair Inkstone. See the guide for LAN or an SSH tunnel you set up yourself.
remote.scanHint: Scan with your phone camera to open Inkstone and fill in the address and code, or enter them manually. The QR code expires with the pairing code.
remote.enableDesc: Paired phones can view tasks on this computer, answer questions, and send text. Tasks still run here; phones cannot connect while Inkstone is closed.
remote.bindDesc: Visible only on your Tailscale network by default. Use "This computer only" with SSH port forwarding, or a specific IP for your LAN. Never exposed on all interfaces.
remote.customAddressDesc: An IPv4 address of a network adapter on this computer
remote.pairDesc: In Inkstone on the phone, enter this computer's address and the 6-digit code. Codes last 5 minutes, work once, and are voided after 5 wrong tries.
remote.pairNeedsRunning: Turn on phone access first; pairing needs the service running
remote.devicesDesc: Revoking disconnects the phone and voids its token immediately; content already on the phone cannot be recalled. Sensitive confirmations (delete, authorize, pay) can only be handled on this computer.
learn.quick.label: Quick learning replies
learn.quick.tryText: Let me try: give me a small exercise and I will answer it myself
office.textOnly: Text only — layout and images are not shown
office.truncated: Content is long; only the beginning is shown
office.noTextChange: No text changes (layout, images or formatting may have changed)
voice.micDenied: Microphone unavailable: allow Inkstone to use the microphone in system settings
voice.title: Local speech to text
voice.desc: Click the mic in the composer to record. The recording is transcribed on this computer and inserted into the composer so you can edit before sending. Audio is never uploaded or kept.
voice.notReady: Not ready: needs the transcription program and a model
voice.hardwareLine: {cpu} · {threads} threads · free memory {free} / {total} GB · CPU load {load}
voice.gpuNote: GPU: {gpu} (this version transcribes on the CPU without GPU acceleration)
voice.modelsDesc: Recommended from this computer’s CPU, memory and current load. Larger is more accurate but slower; recordings are transcribed after they finish, not in real time.
voice.modelLine: {file} · about {size} · uses about {mem} MB of memory
voice.engineDesc: The official whisper.cpp Windows CPU build (whisper-cli). You can also point to one you already have.
voice.languageDesc: Auto suits mixed Chinese and English; a fixed language is usually more accurate.
voice.privacy: The program and models are stored in {dir}. Audio exists only as a temporary file during transcription and is deleted right after.
set.knPersonalDesc: Cross-project preferences, habits and personal rules you confirmed, stored apart from project knowledge. Candidates submitted by other AI tools are reviewed here too.
consent.title: Auto-use basis
consent.desc: The agent asks before using an ordinary local tool for the first time. The same kind of operation (same tool, action and resource) runs automatically only after repeated approvals with no recent denial. Only your real answers in the confirmation dialog are recorded; deleting, sending out, paying, permissions or credentials, and installing always ask.
consent.empty: No records yet. Entries appear after the agent asks to use an ordinary tool and you answer.
consent.stats: Allowed {allows} · denied {denies} · last answer {last} · last auto {auto}
peer.approveWho: "{name}" wants to connect to this computer.
peer.approveRule: Only the projects and operations you tick are opened, and only for this connection; after they disconnect they must ask again.
peer.approveNoProjects: This computer has no registered projects to open yet.
peer.op.transfer: Copy sessions, outputs and project memory
peer.op.send: Send messages, start and stop tasks
peer.approveNotShared: Credentials and personal memory are never opened; sensitive confirmations stay on this computer.
peer.hostDesc: After another Inkstone pairs with a code from the Phone access page, every connection asks for your approval. Active connections are listed here and can be revoked anytime.
peer.hostEmpty: No other Inkstone is connected right now.
peer.clientDesc: Enter the other computer’s address and the pairing code shown on its Phone access page. Pairing only establishes identity; every connection needs their approval, and reconnecting asks again.
peer.knowledgeDone: Imported {accepted} as candidates ({rejected} duplicate or invalid)
peer.viewingRemote: Viewing a session on the other computer (latest 50, nothing kept here)
peer.sendPlaceholder: Message for their session, run on their computer
peer.startPlaceholder: Start a new task in this project: describe what the other computer should do
peer.started: Task started on the other computer
peer.importsDesc: Sessions copied from other Inkstones, keeping the source computer, project and export time. Copies do not sync and do not move running tasks.
sb.label: Status bar
sb.runTip: Running: the model or a tool is working on this turn
sb.waitTip: Waiting for you: a question needs your answer
sb.idleTip: Idle: ready for the next message
sb.phoneTip: Paired phones that can connect (Settings → Phone access)
sb.costTip: Estimated cost of this session so far
